name: Muha Meds Live Resin Disposable | OG Kush
description: OG Kush is a premium quality Indica strain, known for its sweet and pungent aroma. This strain is a cross between Black Domina and Critical Mass, resulting in a relaxing and sedative high. The effects of OG Kush are long-lasting and include a strong body buzz, making it ideal for stress relief and insomnia.
